title: Model pinning UX grooming and microcopy sketches
content:
Purpose:
This doc collects quick wireframe writeups, microcopy drafts, and backlog grooming notes for the model catalog -> endpoint creation -> model version pinning flow. Goal is to finalize acceptance criteria and microcopy for a first-phase UX we can test with Solutions Engs and early DEDICATED customers.

Summary of proposed flows (high level):
1) Catalog list -> select model -> choose baseline model variant and exposure (hosted/dedicated/private).
2) Endpoint creation canvas: name, route, auth, model selection.
3) Pinning panel (new): three pinning modes, validation, and canary rollout controls.
4) Preview + policy: inference SLA target, fallback model, autoscale hints.
5) Confirm + create: show exact API payload that will be created and a short adoption checklist.

Wireframe notes and screen copy drafts
A. Catalog detail pane (right rail)
- Title: "Model: gpt-neoX-20b-quant"
- Subtitle: "Stable profile — v2025-09-18 • latency 80ms (p50)"
- CTA button: primary "Create endpoint" (opens endpoint canvas)
- Inline microcopy under CTA: "Pin a version on create to guarantee repeatable outputs; otherwise the endpoint follows the model channel's compatible latest." (tooltip: "what does 'compatible latest' mean?")
- Badge list: [supported runtimes], [quantization profile], [policy: requires enterprise key]

B. Endpoint creation canvas (initial) — left-to-right form sections
- Form header: "New endpoint" + small link: "Use existing route"
- Form fields: Endpoint name (placeholder: "company-search-query"), Public route (toggle), Auth method (api-key / oauth), Model selection: searchable dropdown with inline version tags.
- Microcopy under Model dropdown: "Choose a model and then pick a version pinning strategy. Pinning ensures inference stability; unpinned endpoints may receive updates."

C. Pinning panel (center of the canvas) — default collapsed; expands when interacting with Model dropdown
- Panel header: "Version pinning (optional)"
- Intro body: "Pin this endpoint to a specific model version to control output drift and reproducibility. You can pin a single version, set a semantic constraint, or opt for automatic updates."
- Radio options:
  1) "Pinned version" — select exact version (dropdown). Tooltip: "Locks inference to this build id. Auto-rollbacks not performed."
  2) "Semantic channel (recommended)" — picks latest model in a channel that meets semantic compatibility rules. Tooltip: "Keeps you on the latest compatible model; good balance of safety & freshness."
  3) "Auto (no pinning)" — endpoint follows default model channel. Tooltip: "Auto updates when we publish compatible variants; used for non-critical workloads."
- Add-on: Small checkbox: "Allow automatic minor upgrades (patch-level only)" with microcopy: "Patch upgrades include minor tokenization or perf improvements; major behavior changes are blocked."

D. Canary & fallback controls (shown only if "Pinned version" or "Semantic channel" selected)
- Canary slider: "Canary traffic %" (0–20% preset chips: 0,5,10,20) with microcopy: "Route a small percentage to a new version before full switch."
- Fallback model: searchable input with label: "Fallback model"
